entries.title: Jeremiah 31:1
segments: At that time, says the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:2
segments: So says the LORD, The people [who were] left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I will go to give him rest.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:3
segments: The LORD has appeared to me from afar, [saying], Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with loving-kindness I have drawn you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:4
segments: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel. You shall again put on your tambourines, and shall go forth in the dances of those who rejoice.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:5
segments: You shall yet plant vines on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall eat [them] as common things.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:6
segments: For there shall be a day [that] the watchmen on Mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise and let us go up to Zion to the LORD our God!

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:7
segments: For so says the LORD, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations. Cry out, give praise and say, O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:8
segments: Behold, I will bring them from the north country and gather them from the corners of the earth, and with [them] the blind and the lame, the woman with child and she who is in labor with child, together; a great company shall return there.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:9
segments: They shall come with weeping, and with prayers I will lead them. I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way; they shall not stumble in it, for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim [is] My firstborn.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:10
segments: Hear the word of the LORD, O nations, and declare [it] in the coastlands afar off. And say, He who scattered Israel will gather him and keep him, as a shepherd [keeps] his flock.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:11
segments: For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of the one stronger than he.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:12
segments: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the sons of the flock and the herd. And their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not pine away any more at all.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:13
segments: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them and make them rejoice from their affliction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:14
segments: And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness, and My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:15
segments: So says the LORD: A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing [and] bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her sons; she refuses to be comforted for her sons, because they [are] not.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:16
segments: So says the LORD: Hold back your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, says the LORD. And they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:17
segments: And there is hope for your future, says the LORD, that [your] sons shall come again to their own border.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:18
segments: I have surely heard Ephraim mourning to himself, [saying], You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bull not broken in; turn me, and I shall be turned. For You [are] the LORD my God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:19
segments: Surely after I was turned, I repented; and after I was taught, I struck on [my] thigh. I was ashamed, yea, I even blushed, because I bore the disgrace of my youth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:20
segments: [Is] Ephraim My dear son? [Is he] a delightful child? For as often as I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still. Therefore My bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:21
segments: Set up waymarks, make sign posts for yourself. Set your heart toward the highway, the way you went. Turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these your cities.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:22
segments: How long will you turn to and fro, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land; a woman shall enclose a man.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:23
segments: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Again they shall speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall again bring their captivity: The LORD bless you, O home of justice [and] mountain of holiness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:24
segments: And farmers, and those going forth with flocks, shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities of it together.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:25
segments: For I satisfy the weary soul, and I fill every sorrowful soul.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:26
segments: On this I awoke and looked up; and my sleep was sweet to me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:27
segments: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:28
segments: And it shall be, as I have watched over them to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so I will watch over them to build, and to plant, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:29
segments: In those days they shall not say any more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the sons are dull.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:30
segments: But every man shall die in his iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be dull.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:31
segments: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will cut a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:32
segments: not according to the covenant that I cut with their fathers in the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which covenant of Mine they broke, although I was a husband to them, says the LORD;

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:33
segments: but this [shall be] the covenant that I will cut with the house of Israel: After those days, says the LORD, I will put My law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:34
segments: And they shall no more teach each man his neighbor and each man his brother, saying, Know the LORD; for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sins no more.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:35
segments: So says the LORD, who gives the sun for a light by day and the laws of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who divides the sea when its waves roar; the LORD of hosts [is] His name;

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:36
segments: if those ordinances depart from Me, says the LORD, the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before Me forever.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:37
segments: So says the LORD, If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be searched out, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:38
segments: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the Tower of Hananeel to the Corner Gate.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:39
segments: And the measuring line shall yet go before it to the hill Gareb, and shall go around to Goath.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:40
segments: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook of Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, [shall be] holy to the LORD. It shall not be plucked up nor thrown down any more forever.
